notes: Every Modules/<id>/ and src/<dir>/ must belong to a mod here; tools/ci/mods.py check fails otherwise. A release mod ships when its SubModule.xml Version has no <id>/<version> tag yet. 'owns' lists what ships (sources, module folder, build inputs; not tests): changing any of it, or a file the 'project' csproj embeds, needs a Version bump.

mods.reason: In-game engine probe used by local tests; not a player-facing mod.
